## [2.4.1] - 2026-09-06

### Added
- Dual Coordinate Systems Support (Tropical & J2000):
- Added support for both Tropical (Apparent Ecliptic of Date / Astro.com) and J2000 (Astrometric / Epoch J2000.0) coordinate frameworks.
- Interactive UI toggle button (🌐 Tropical (Astro.com) / 🔭 J2000 (Astrometric)) in chart controls and data table header.
- Dynamic client-side switching that instantly updates the SVG chart wheel, planetary degree glyphs, unequal house cusps, angular axes, aspect chords, data tables, aspect grid, compatibility score circle, and aspect interpretation cards.
- Tropical coordinates use true ecliptic of date accounting for equinox precession, nutation, and light-time corrections, matching Astro.com and professional Swiss Ephemeris calculations to the exact arcminute.
- Bilingual localization support (Hebrew & English) for coordinate system labels, descriptions, and tooltips.
- Universal Standard Time (Non-DST) Notice & Consistency:
- Clarified and standardized time input across forms: times are entered in the location's standard astronomical GMT offset without daylight saving time (DST).
- Added bilingual guidance notices (tzStandardNotice) on all timezone input fields and profile edit modals in both Hebrew and English.
- Normalized all reference cities worldwide to standard non-DST offsets (e.g., standard GMT+2 for 30°-45°E, GMT-5 for NYC, GMT+0 for LON, GMT+1 for PAR).
- Universal longitude-based geographic GMT offset estimation (round(lon / 15.0)) without any country-specific hardcoding.

## [2.4.0] - 2026-09-06

### Added
- Professional Astrological Wheel Enhancements:
- Replaced standard equal house system with precise Porphyry Unequal Houses.
- Dynamic SVG house sectors with calculated exact midpoints for labeling.
- Angular axes explicitly labeled with exact degrees (ASC, IC, DSC, MC).
- Added exact planetary degrees (0-29°) physically rendered next to each glyph on the wheel.
- Synastry Aspect Matrix & Planetary Data Tables:
- Implemented a professional triangular/rectangular Aspect Grid (Matrix) displaying all calculated planetary aspects and orbs in the UI.
- Added a responsive Planetary Data Table listing exact longitudes and house placements for all calculated bodies.

## [2.3.0] - 2026-09-06

### Added
- Individual Person Profiles Repository (saved_people.json):
- Independent persistent storage for individual astrological profiles (name, birth date, exact time/hour, city, and UTC timezone offset).
- Seeded with initial profiles from existing records (SA, YS, AM, Alex, Jordan).
- Full RESTful API in app.py: GET /api/people, POST /api/people, PUT /api/people/<id>, and DELETE /api/people/<id>.
- Auto-sync integration: Saving a couple analysis now automatically registers and updates both partners in the person profile repository.

- Independent Saved Person Selectors & Quick Swapping:
- Dedicated dropdown selector for Partner A and Partner B independently, enabling instant pairing of any saved person against any other partner.
- Centered 🔄 Swap Partners (A ⇄ B) 1-click button to flip Partner A and Partner B with all coordinates and timezone data preserved.

- Live Saved Status Indicators & 1-Click Action Buttons:
- Real-time comparison between active form inputs and the person database.
- Displays ✓ Saved when details match.
- Displays Modified and an immediate 💾 Update button when details (e.g. birth hour) are edited.
- Displays Not saved and a 1-click 💾 Save button when entering a new person.

- Interactive Results Page "Edit Details & Compare Partner" System:
- Top navigation and Partner Card ✏️ Edit Details / Compare Partner button on result.html.
- Opens a dedicated modal allowing instant adjustments to the hour of birth, switching Partner B to a different saved person, and recalculating via ⚡ Recalculate & Compare.
- Direct individual 💾 Save / ✓ Saved badges on the p

        export const TRANSLATIONS = {

        };

- Compatible with modern ES modules and direct browser scripts via global window exposure.
- Dynamic page layout direction flipping (document.documentElement.dir = 'rtl' / 'ltr') and RTL-specific CSS enhancements.
- Interactive language switcher toggle button (🌐 עברית (HE) / 🌐 English (EN)) in the top navigation bar of both pages.
- Comprehensive localization across all layers:
- Headers, subtitles, buttons, form inputs, placeholders, and tooltips.
- Live geocoding status badges, confirmations, and alerts.
- Astrological vocabulary: 12 Zodiac signs (טלה through דגים), 10 planets + ASC / MC, 5 major aspects (צמידות, טריין, סקסטיל, סקוויר, אופוזיציה), and the 4 elements.
- Synastry category bars and compatibility rating verdicts.

- Transparent Live Geocoding Fallback & Source Reporting:

### Fixed
- Partner Profile Card Degree & Position Rendering:
- Corrected degree and minute mapping (sign_deg and sign_min keys alongside deg/min in compute_chart) so planet position rows display exact coordinates (e.g., 1° 45' ☉ Pisces) rather than missing degrees (° 00').
- Added robust fallback to pre-formatted coordinate strings when switching languages.
- Streamlined Ascendant row labels (ASC Rising / אופק (ASC)) and applied text-nowrap to prevent awkward line breaks on high-density cards.

# [2.1.0] - 2026-09-06

### Added
- Curated World Cities Catalog (cities.json):
- Offline-capable database of over 120 major world cities and metropolitan regions across all continents.
- Includes exact pre-verified latitudes, longitudes, canonical display names, and default UTC timezone offsets.
- Searchable autocomplete dropdown (<datalist>) in city inputs with instant filtering.
- Instant selection automatically locks in coordinates, auto-fills default UTC offset, and displays an interactive verification badge (📍 Verified: Lat, Lon · Country).
- Fallback to live Nominatim geocoding for unlisted custom locations.
- Saved Analyses Management System (Full CRUD):
- Persistent JSON database storage (saved_analyses.json) preserving couple calculation profiles across restarts.
- Complete REST API:
- GET /api/analyses: list all saved profiles.
- POST /api/analyses: save a new couple profile.
- GET /api/analyses/<id>: retrieve individual profile.
- PUT /api/analyses/<id>: update/edit saved couple data.
- DELETE /api/analyses/<id>: remove profile from storage.
- Interactive UI Management Panel on homepage:
- Searchable list of saved couple profiles.
- Load into Form: Populates form inputs with a single click.
- Inline Edit Modal: Allows editing names, dates, times, cities, timezones, and notes.
- Delete: Instant removal with confirmation dialog.
- Quick Save Actions:
- "💾 Save to My Analyses" button directly on the homepage input form.
- "💾 Save to My Analyses" button in the result report action bar.

Overall summary verdict\n    if overall_pct >= 85:\n        verdict_key = \"verdict_85\"\n        verdict = \"Exceptional Cosmic Affinity: Rare magnetic harmony with deep mutual understanding and lasting soul connection.\"\n    elif overall_pct >= 70:\n        verdict_key = \"verdict_70\"\n        verdict = \"High Astrological Resonance: Natural chemistry and supportive aspects outshine minor differences.\"\n    elif overall_pct >= 55:\n        verdict_key = \"verdict_55\"\n        verdict = \"Dynamic & Complementary Bond: Meaningful passion paired with growth opportunities that require conscious empathy.\"\n    else:\n        verdict_key = \"verdict_0\"\n        verdict = \"Karmic Growth Catalyst: Intense friction and distinct temperaments; great personal transformation if communication is nurtured.\"\n\n    return {\n        \"aspects\": aspects,\n        \"overall_score\": overall_pct,\n        \"chemistry_score\": chemistry_pct,\n        \"emotional_score\": emotional_pct,\n        \"intellectual_score\": intellectual_pct,\n        \"stability_score\": stability_pct,\n        \"verdict\": verdict,\n        \"verdict_key\": verdict_key,\n        \"raw_points\": round(raw_score, 1)\n    }\n\ndef calculate_synastry(c1, c2):\n    \"\"\"Calculates all inter-chart aspects and scores for both Tropical and J2000 systems.\"\"\"\n    c1_trop = c1.get(\"systems\", {}).get(\"tropical\", c1)\n    c2_trop = c2.get(\"systems\", {}).get(\"tropical\", c2)\n    c1_j2000 = c1.get(\"systems\", {}).get(\"j2000\", c1)\n    c2_j2000 = c2.get(\"systems\", {}).get(\"j2000\", c2)\n\n    syn_tropical = _calculate_synastry_single(c1_trop, c2_trop)\n    syn_j2000 = _calculate_synastry_single(c1_j2000, c2_j2000)\n\n    return {\n        \"systems\": {\n            \"tropical\": syn_tropical,\n            \"j2000\": syn_j2000\n        },\n        # Default top-level fields to tropical for backwards compatibility\n        **syn_tropical\n    }\n\n# --- ROUTES ---\n@app.route('/', methods=['GET'])\ndef index():\n    return render_template('index.html', app_version=APP_VERSION)\n\n@app.route('/analyze', methods=['POST'])\ndef analyze():\n    try:\n        p1_inputs = {\n            'name': request.form['p1_name'].strip(),\n            'date_str': request.form['p1_date'],\n            'time_str': request.form['p1_time'],\n            'city_str': request.form['p1_city'].strip(),\n            'tz_str': request.form['p1_tz'].strip()\n        }\n        p2_inputs = {\n            'name': request.form['p2_name'].strip(),\n            'date_str': request.form['p2_date'],\n            'time_str': request.form['p2_time'],\n            'city_str': request.form['p2_city'].strip(),\n            'tz_str': request.form['p2_tz'].strip()\n        }\n        \n        # Calculate individual charts\n        chart1 = compute_chart(**p1_inputs)\n        chart2 = compute_chart(**p2_inputs)\n        \n        # Calculate Synastry\n        synastry = calculate_synastry(chart1, chart2)\n        \n        # Bundle everything for frontend visualization\n        payload = {\n            \"chart1\": chart1,\n            \"chart2\": chart2,\n            \"synastry\": synastry,\n            \"zodiac_data\": ZODIAC_DATA\n        }\n        \n        return render_template(\n            'result.html',\n            p1=chart1,\n            p2=chart2,\n            synastry=synastry,\n            payload_json=json.dumps(payload),\n            app_version=APP_VERSION\n        )\n        \n    except Exception as e:\n        import traceback\n        return render_template(\n            'index.html',\n            error=f\"Error calculating charts: {str(e)}\",\n            app_version=APP_VERSION\n        )"
}

1: # AstroMatch Environment Configuration
2:
3: ## Python Environment
4: - Conda environment path: D:\Resources\Anaconda3\envs\astromatch
5: - Conda environment name: astromatch
6: - Python interpreter: D:\Resources\Anaconda3\envs\astromatch\python.exe
7: - Python version: 3.11
8:
9: ## Running the Application
10: - Always activate the environment before running: conda activate astromatch
11: - Or use the full interpreter path: D:\Resources\Anaconda3\envs\astromatch\python.exe app.py
12: - The Flask dev server runs on http://127.0.0.1:5050
13:
14: ## Key Dependencies
15: - flask — Web framework
16: - skyfield — Pure-Python astronomy library (no C extensions needed)
17: - numpy — Numerical computations
18: - geopy — Geocoding city names to lat/lon coordinates
19: - NASA ephemeris file de421.bsp is already included in the project root
20:
21: ## Technical Constraints
22: - No C++ compiler available — Do not use pyswisseph, kerykeion, flatlib, or any library requiring C extensions.
23: - All astrological math (zodiac signs, ascendant, aspects, orbs) is implemented manually in Python.
24: - Skyfield is used purely for astronomical planet positions.

1: # AstroMatch Pro (v2.4.1)
2:
3: Professional-grade Astrological Compatibility (Synastry) & Interactive Celestial Maps web application.
4:
5: AstroMatch Pro calculates the precise astronomical positions of planets for two individuals based on their exact birth date, time, timezone offset, and city. It computes celestial angles, 12 house cusps, geometric aspect chords between charts, and visualizes them on interactive Astrological Maps (Synastry Bi-Wheel and Natal Charts).
6:
7: ---
8:
9: ## Key Features
10:
11: - Dual Coordinate Systems with Interactive Toggle (New in v2.4.1):
12: - Tropical (Date / Astro.com): Western astrology standard based on the apparent ecliptic of date, accounting for equinox precession, nutation, and light-time corrections. Matches Astro.com and Swiss Ephemeris calculations to the exact arcminute.
13: - J2000 (Astrometric): Modern astrophysical coordinate system fixed to the standard epoch J2000.0 without date precession.
14: - Instant UI Switch Button: Toggle seamlessly between 🌐 Tropical (Astro.com) and 🔭 J2000 (Astrometric) on the chart toolbar and data tables without page reloads.
15: - All visual elements (SVG chart wheel, planetary degree glyphs, house cusps, aspect grid, compatibility scores, and aspect catalog) dynamically update in real time.
16:
17: - Professional Astrological Charts (v2.4.0):
18: - Porphyry Unequal Houses: Transitioned from equal houses to precise Porphyry unequal houses with dynamic visual SVG sectors and centered Roman numerals.
19: - Exact Degrees on Wheel: Explicitly rendered degree values (0-29°) next to each planetary glyph on the chart.
20: - Distinct Angular Axes: Distinctly labeled ASC, IC, DSC, and MC with their exact calculated degrees on the SVG wheel.
21: - Aspect Grid (Matrix): Triangular (Natal) and Rectangular (Synastry) Aspect Grid tables rendering full aspect and exact orb data.
22: - Planetary Data Tables: Tabular display of precise planetary longitude (Sign, Degree, Minute) and house placement alongside the chart.
23:
24: - Individual Person Profiles & Partner Comparison System (New in v2.3.0):
25: - Saved People Directory (saved_people.json): Save individual birth profiles (birth date, exact hour of birth, city, timezone) for rapid pairing.
26: - Independent Partner Selectors: Select any saved individual for Partner A and Partner B independently to quickly compare against multiple partners.
27: - Live Save Status Indicators: Real-time comparison between entered details and saved records (✓ Saved, Modified 💾 Update, or Not saved 💾 Save).
28: - Interactive Results Page Comparison Modal: Easily adjust the hour of birth or switch partners directly from the results view and recalculate instantaneously.
29: - 1-Click Partner Swap: Instantly flip Partner A and Partner B with coordinates and parameters preserved.
30: - Dual-Tab Directory: Tabbed manager on the main page for both Saved Couple Analyses and Individual People Profiles.
31:
32: - Multi-Language Architecture (Hebrew & English):
33: - Built-in bilingual support with instant language switching (🌐 עברית / English).
34: - Automatic RTL (Right-to-Left) and LTR layout adaptation.
35: - Centralized dictionary in static/translations.js exporting TRANSLATIONS for both ES modules and browser scripts.
36: - Complete coverage: UI forms, badges, modals, tooltips, astrological terms, and compatibility verdicts.
37: - User preference persisted across visits in localStorage.
38:
39: - Version Tracking & Metadata Display:
40: - Global APP_VERSION = "2.4.1" in app.py.
41: - All saved analyses and people profiles are stamped with the version number used ("version": "2.4.1").
42: - Saved cards display a version badge (e.g. v2.3.0).
43: - Persistent application footer displayed below the program on all screens.
44:
45: - Curated World Cities & Verification:
46: - Pre-verified catalog of 120+ global cities across all continents with exact latitudes, longitudes, and default UTC offsets.
47: - Searchable autocomplete dropdown (<datalist>) for selecting birth cities.
48: - Selecting a city locks in verified coordinates, auto-fills the timezone offset, and displays an instant verification badge (📍 Verified: Lat, Lon · Country).
49: - Fallback to live geocoding for unlisted custom locations.
50:
51: - Saved Analyses Management (Full CRUD):
52: - Persistent JSON database storage (saved_analyses.json) so your couple profiles are saved across sessions.
53: - Dedicated manager on the homepage:
54: - List & Search: Browse all saved couples with metadata and birth details.
55: - Load into Form: Populate both partners' details with one click.
56: - Inline Edit: Edit names, birth dates, times, cities, or notes in a clean modal dialog.
57: - Delete: Remove profiles with instant UI update.
58: - Quick-save buttons on both the homepage form and the result report header.
59:
60: - Interactive Astrological Maps (Pure SVG Engine):
61: - Synastry Bi-Wheel: Partner A on the inner track, Partner B on the outer track, with color-coded inter-chart aspect chords in the center.
62: - Individual Natal Charts: Standalone chart wheels for Partner A and Partner B with 12 house sectors (Roman numerals I–XII) and natal aspect lines.
63: - 12 Zodiac Segments: Elemental color-coding (Fire, Earth, Air, Water), traditional astrological glyphs (♈ to ♓), and 5° / 10° degree ticks.
64: - Ascendant Alignment: Eastern horizon orientation (Ascendant at 9 o'clock / 180°), with longitudes advancing counterclockwise.
65: - Dynamic Aspect Chords: Color-coded geometric chords (Trines in green, Sextiles in cyan, Conjunctions in gold, Squares in crimson, Oppositions in ruby) with line weight and opacity tied to orb tightness.
66: - Anti-Collision Layout: Intelligent radial staggering prevents overlapping glyphs during tight conjunctions.
67: - Interactive Hover: Hovering over planets or aspect lines displays exact degrees, houses, and rich interpretations.
68: - High-Resolution Export: One-click Export SVG and Export PNG (1800×1800) buttons.
69:
70: - Expanded Planetary Roster & House Mathematics:
71: - Full 10-body roster: Sun (☉), Moon (☽), Mercury (☿), Venus (♀), Mars (♂), Jupiter (♃), Saturn (♄), Uranus (♅), Neptune (♆), Pluto (♇).
72: - Angles: Ascendant ($ASC$), Midheaven ($MC$), Descendant ($DSC$), Imum Coeli ($IC$).
73: - 12 Porphyry Unequal House Cusps with automatic house assignment for each body.
74:
75: - Compatibility Breakdown:
76: - Overall Synastry Score (0–100%) with cosmic verdict.
77: - Categorized breakdown: Romantic Chemistry, Emotional Safety, Mental Rapport, Long-Term Stability.
78: - Filterable aspect catalog (All, Harmonious, Dynamic Friction).
79:
80: - Strict "No C++ Compiler" Design:
81: - Built with pure Python astronomy tools (skyfield) and NASA's de421.bsp ephemeris.
82: - Zero reliance on C-extensions or compiled packages like pyswisseph, kerykeion, or flatlib.
83:
84: ---
85:
86: ## Environment Setup & Quick Start
87:
88: ### 1. Conda Environment
89: The environment is configured at D:\Resources\Anaconda3\envs\astromatch:
90:
91: 

92: # Activate the environment
93: conda activate astromatch
94: 
95: # Or activate by prefix
96: conda activate D:\Resources\Anaconda3\envs\astromatch
97:

98:
99: To recreate the environment on a new computer:
100: 
101: conda env create -f environment.yml
102:

103:
104: ### 2. Running the Application
105: 
106: # Directly with the environment's python interpreter
107: & "D:\Resources\Anaconda3\envs\astromatch\python.exe" app.py
108:

109: Open your browser and navigate to: http://127.0.0.1:5050
110:
111: ### 3. IDE Integration (Antigravity & VS Code)
112: - .vscode/settings.json is preconfigured with python.defaultInterpreterPath pointing directly to the astromatch interpreter.
113: - .vscode/launch.json provides a one-click debug launcher (F5).
114: - .vscode/tasks.json provides a default build/run task.
115: - .agents/rules/astromatch-environment.md instructs Antigravity to always use this isolated environment.
116:
117: ---
118:
119: ## Project Structure
120:
121:

123: ├── .agents/

137: ├── CHANGELOG.md                       # Semantic version history (v2.4.0)
138: ├── cities.json                        # Curated database of world cities & coordinates
139: ├── de421.bsp                          # NASA JPL planetary ephemeris (~16 MB)
140: ├── environment.yml                    # Conda environment specification
141: ├── README.md                          # Project documentation
142: └── saved_analyses.json                # Persistent JSON database for couple profiles

207: def format_zodiac(lon_deg):
208: """Convert ecliptic longitude (0-360) into sign, deg, min, symbol."""
209: norm_deg = lon_deg % 360
210: sign_idx = int(norm_deg // 30) % 12
211: sign_info = ZODIAC_DATA[sign_idx]
212: deg_in_sign = int(norm_deg % 30)
213: min_in_sign = int(round((norm_deg % 1) * 60))
214: if min_in_sign == 60:
215: deg_in_sign += 1
216: min_in_sign = 0
217: return {
218: "sign": sign_info["name"],
219: "symbol": sign_info["symbol"],
220: "element": sign_info["element"],
221: "color": sign_info["color"],
222: "deg": deg_in_sign,
223: "min": min_in_sign,
224: "formatted": f"{deg_in_sign}° {min_in_sign:02d}' {sign_info['symbol']} {sign_info['name']}",
225: "raw": float(norm_deg)
226: }

228: def calculate_angles_and_houses(t, lat, lon, coord_system='tropical'):
229: """
230: Calculate Ascendant, Midheaven (MC), Descendant, Imum Coeli (IC),
231: and 12 Equal House Cusps. Supports 'tropical' (GAST) and 'j2000' (GMST).
232: """
233: gast_hours = t.gast if coord_system == 'tropical' else t.gmst
234: lst_hours = (gast_hours + lon / 15.0) % 24
235: ramc_deg = (lst_hours * 15.0) % 360
236: eps_rad = np.radians(23.4392911) # Obliquity of Ecliptic
237:
238: ramc_rad = np.radians(ramc_deg)
239: lat_rad = np.radians(lat)
240:
241: # Ascendant
242: num = np.cos(ramc_rad)
243: den = -((np.sin(ramc_rad) np.cos(eps_rad)) + (np.tan(lat_rad) np.sin(eps_rad)))
244: asc_deg = float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(num, den)) % 360)
245:
246: # Midheaven (MC)
247: mc_deg = float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(np.sin(ramc_rad), np.cos(ramc_rad) * np.cos(eps_rad))) % 360)
248:
249: # Descendant and IC
250: dsc_deg = float((asc_deg + 180) % 360)
251: ic_deg = float((mc_deg + 180) % 360)
252:
253: # Porphyry Houses Calculation
254: def normalize_angle(deg):
255: return deg % 360
256:
257: arc_asc_ic = normalize_angle(ic_deg - asc_deg)
258: arc_ic_dsc = normalize_angle(dsc_deg - ic_deg)
259: arc_dsc_mc = normalize_angle(mc_deg - dsc_deg)
260: arc_mc_asc = normalize_angle(asc_deg - mc_deg)
261:
262: cusps = []
263:
264: # Q1: ASC to IC
265: cusps.append(asc_deg)
266: cusps.append(normalize_angle(asc_deg + arc_asc_ic / 3.0))
267: cusps.append(normalize_angle(asc_deg + 2.0 * arc_asc_ic / 3.0))
268:
269: # Q2: IC to DSC
270: cusps.append(ic_deg)
271: cusps.append(normalize_angle(ic_deg + arc_ic_dsc / 3.0))
272: cusps.append(normalize_angle(ic_deg + 2.0 * arc_ic_dsc / 3.0))
273:
274: # Q3: DSC to MC
275: cusps.append(dsc_deg)
276: cusps.append(normalize_angle(dsc_deg + arc_dsc_mc / 3.0))
277: cusps.append(normalize_angle(dsc_deg + 2.0 * arc_dsc_mc / 3.0))
278:
279: # Q4: MC to ASC
280: cusps.append(mc_deg)
281: cusps.append(normalize_angle(mc_deg + arc_mc_asc / 3.0))
282: cusps.append(normalize_angle(mc_deg + 2.0 * arc_mc_asc / 3.0))
283:
284: houses = []
285: for i in range(12):
286: cusp_deg = cusps[i]
287: houses.append({
288: "house": i + 1,
289: "cusp": round(float(cusp_deg), 2),
290: "zodiac": format_zodiac(cusp_deg)
291: })
292:
293: return {
294: "asc": asc_deg,
295: "mc": mc_deg,
296: "dsc": dsc_deg,
297: "ic": ic_deg,
298: "houses": houses
299: }

301: def get_house_for_lon(lon_deg, cusps_list):
302: """Determine which unequal house (1-12) an ecliptic longitude falls into."""
303: lon_deg = lon_deg % 360
304: for i in range(12):
305: cusp_current = cusps_list[i]
306: cusp_next = cusps_list[(i + 1) % 12]
307: if cusp_current < cusp_next:
308: if cusp_current <= lon_deg < cusp_next:
309: return i + 1
310: else:
311: if lon_deg >= cusp_current or lon_deg < cusp_next:
312: return i + 1
313: return 1

316: """Compute angles, houses, planets, and natal aspects for a specific coordinate system."""
317: angles = calculate_angles_and_houses(t, lat, lon, coord_system=coord_system)

328: _, lon_ecl, _ = apparent.ecliptic_latlon('date')
329: else: # 'j2000'
330: astrometric = earth.at(t).observe(p_obj)
331: _, lon_ecl, _ = astrometric.ecliptic_latlon()
332:

345: "sign_deg": zodiac["deg"],

347: "deg": zodiac["deg"],
348: "min": zodiac["min"],
349: "sign_color": zodiac["color"],
350: "formatted": zodiac["formatted"],
351: "house": house_num
352: }
353: planets_list.append(planet_entry)
354: planets_dict[p_name] = planet_entry
355:

357: asc_zodiac = format_zodiac(asc_deg)
358: asc_entry = {
359: "name": "Ascendant",
360: "symbol": "ASC",
361: "color": "#ec4899",
362: "category": "angle",
363: "lon": round(asc_deg, 2),
364: "sign": asc_zodiac["sign"],
365: "sign_symbol": asc_zodiac["symbol"],
366: "sign_deg": asc_zodiac["deg"],
367: "sign_min": asc_zodiac["min"],
368: "deg": asc_zodiac["deg"],
369: "min": asc_zodiac["min"],
370: "sign_color": asc_zodiac["color"],
371: "formatted": asc_zodiac["formatted"],
372: "house": 1
373: }
374:
375: mc_zodiac = format_zodiac(angles["mc"])
376: mc_entry = {
377: "name": "Midheaven",
378: "symbol": "MC",
379: "color": "#8b5cf6",
380: "category": "angle",
381: "lon": round(angles["mc"], 2),
382: "sign": mc_zodiac["sign"],
383: "sign_symbol": mc_zodiac["symbol"],
384: "sign_deg": mc_zodiac["deg"],
385: "sign_min": mc_zodiac["min"],
386: "deg": mc_zodiac["deg"],
387: "min": mc_zodiac["min"],
388: "sign_color": mc_zodiac["color"],
389: "formatted": mc_zodiac["formatted"],
390: "house": get_house_for_lon(angles["mc"], cusps_deg_list)
391: }
392:
393: # Natal aspects for this individual
394: all_points = planets_list + [asc_entry]
395: natal_aspects = []
396: for i in range(len(all_points)):
397: for j in range(i + 1, len(all_points)):
398: pt1 = all_points[i]
399: pt2 = all_points[j]
400: diff = abs(pt1["lon"] - pt2["lon"])
401: diff = min(diff, 360.0 - diff)
402:
403: for asp_name, asp_cfg in ASPECT_CONFIGS.items():
404: orb = abs(diff - asp_cfg["angle"])
405: if orb <= asp_cfg["max_orb"]:
406: natal_aspects.append({
407: "p1": pt1["name"],
408: "p1_symbol": pt1["symbol"],
409: "p1_lon": pt1["lon"],
410: "p2": pt2["name"],
411: "p2_symbol": pt2["symbol"],
412: "p2_lon": pt2["lon"],
413: "aspect": asp_name,
414: "angle": asp_cfg["angle"],
415: "orb": round(orb, 1),
416: "color": asp_cfg["color"],
417: "nature": asp_cfg["nature"]
418: })
419: break
420:
421: return {
422: "system": coord_system,
423: "asc": round(asc_deg, 2),
424: "mc": round(angles["mc"], 2),
425: "dsc": round(angles["dsc"], 2),
426: "ic": round(angles["ic"], 2),
427: "houses": angles["houses"],
428: "planets": planets_list,
429: "planets_dict": planets_dict,
430: "asc_point": asc_entry,
431: "mc_point": mc_entry,
432: "natal_aspects": natal_aspects,
433: # Big Three shorthand

436: "asc_sign": asc_zodiac["sign"],

439: def compute_chart(name, date_str, time_str, tz_str, city_str):
440: """Calculates all planetary coordinates, angles, houses, and natal aspects."""
441: # Resolve City Coordinates (Curated DB first, then live OpenStreetMap/Nominatim fallback)
442: matched_city = find_city_in_db(city_str)
443: if matched_city:
444: lat, lon = matched_city['lat'], matched_city['lon']
445: address = matched_city['display']
446: source = "Curated Database"
447: else:
448: location = geolocator.geocode(city_str)
449: if not location:
450: raise ValueError(f"Could not locate '{city_str}' on OpenStreetMap or local database. Please check spelling or specify country (e.g., 'Kiryat Gat, Israel').")
451: lat, lon = location.latitude, location.longitude
452: address = location.address
453: source = "OpenStreetMap"
454:
455: # Parse date and time
456: dt = datetime.strptime(f"{date_str} {time_str}", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
457:
458: # Parse timezone offset e.g. +02:00, -05:00, +2, -5
459: try:
460: tz_clean = tz_str.strip()
461: sign = 1 if tz_clean[0] != '-' else -1
462: core = tz_clean.lstrip('+-')
463: if ':' in core:
464: parts = core.split(':')
465: h = int(parts[0])
466: m = int(parts[1])
467: else:
468: h = int(core)
469: m = 0
470: total_offset = sign * (h + m / 60.0)
471: except Exception:
472: total_offset = 0.0
473:
474: ts = load.timescale()
475: t = ts.utc(dt.year, dt.month, dt.day, dt.hour - total_offset, dt.minute)
476:
477: # Compute both Tropical (Date / Astro.com) and J2000 (Astrometric) systems
478: trop_data = _calculate_chart_system(t, lat, lon, coord_system='tropical')
479: j2000_data = _calculate_chart_system(t, lat, lon, coord_system='j2000')
480:
481: return {
482: "name": name,
483: "date": date_str,
484: "time": time_str,
485: "tz": tz_str,
486: "city": city_str,
487: "location_address": address,
488: "location_source": source,
489: "lat": round(lat, 4),
490: "lon": round(lon, 4),
491: "systems": {
492: "tropical": trop_data,
493: "j2000": j2000_data
494: },
495: # Default top-level properties to tropical for backwards compatibility
496: **trop_data
497: }

499: def _calculate_synastry_single(c1_sys, c2_sys):
500: """Calculates inter-chart aspects, compatibility score breakdown, and interpretations for one system."""
501: aspects = []
502:
503: # Points to compare
504: pts1 = c1_sys["planets"] + [c1_sys["asc_point"]]
505: pts2 = c2_sys["planets"] + [c2_sys["asc_point"]]
506:
507: raw_score = 0.0
508: category_scores = {
509: "chemistry": 50.0,
510: "emotional": 50.0,
511: "intellectual": 50.0,
512: "stability": 50.0
513: }
514:
515: for p1 in pts1:
516: for p2 in pts2:
517: diff = abs(p1["lon"] - p2["lon"])
518: diff = min(diff, 360.0 - diff)
519:
520: for asp_name, asp_cfg in ASPECT_CONFIGS.items():
521: orb = abs(diff - asp_cfg["angle"])
522: if orb <= asp_cfg["max_orb"]:
523: # Compute tightness factor (1.0 = exact, 0.0 = at orb boundary)
524: tightness = max(0.0, 1.0 - (orb / asp_cfg["max_orb"]))
525:
526: # Look up custom interpretation and key
527: pair_key1 = f"{p1['name']}-{p2['name']}-{asp_name}"
528: pair_key2 = f"{p2['name']}-{p1['name']}-{asp_name}"
529: if pair_key1 in CUSTOM_INTERPRETATIONS:
530: aspect_key = pair_key1
531: meaning = CUSTOM_INTERPRETATIONS[pair_key1]
532: elif pair_key2 in CUSTOM_INTERPRETATIONS:
533: aspect_key = pair_key2
534: meaning = CUSTOM_INTERPRETATIONS[pair_key2]
535: else:
536: aspect_key = f"generic-{asp_name}"
537: meaning = f"Dynamic planetary link: {p1['name']} {asp_name} {p2['name']} creates active energy exchange between {p1['name']}'s drive and {p2['name']}'s essence."
538:
539: # Point calculation
540: weight = PLANETS_CONFIG.get(p1['name'], {}).get('weight', 1.0) * \
541: PLANETS_CONFIG.get(p2['name'], {}).get('weight', 1.0)
542: pt = asp_cfg["base_points"] tightness weight
543: raw_score += pt
544:
545: # Categorized impact
546: pair_names = {p1['name'], p2['name']}
547: if pair_names & {'Venus', 'Mars'}:
548: category_scores["chemistry"] += pt * 1.5
549: if pair_names & {'Moon', 'Neptune', 'Sun'}:
550: category_scores["emotional"] += pt * 1.3
551: if pair_names & {'Mercury', 'Uranus'}:
552: category_scores["intellectual"] += pt * 1.4
553: if pair_names & {'Saturn', 'Jupiter', 'Ascendant'}:
554: category_scores["stability"] += pt * 1.3
555:
556: aspects.append({
557: "p1_planet": p1["name"],
558: "p1_symbol": p1["symbol"],
559: "p1_lon": p1["lon"],
560: "p1_sign": p1["sign"],
561: "p2_planet": p2["name"],
562: "p2_symbol": p2["symbol"],
563: "p2_lon": p2["lon"],
564: "p2_sign": p2["sign"],
565: "aspect": asp_name,
566: "angle": asp_cfg["angle"],
567: "orb": round(orb, 1),
568: "tightness": round(tightness, 2),
569: "nature": asp_cfg["nature"],
570: "color": asp_cfg["color"],
571: "meaning": meaning,
572: "aspect_key": aspect_key,
573: "points": round(pt, 1)
574: })
575: break
576:
577: # Sort aspects by tightness
578: aspects.sort(key=lambda x: x["orb"])
579:
580: # Normalize scores between 20 and 99%
581: def clamp_score(val):
582: return int(max(25, min(98, round(val))))
583:
584: overall_pct = clamp_score(50 + (raw_score * 0.9))
585: chemistry_pct = clamp_score(category_scores["chemistry"])
586: emotional_pct = clamp_score(category_scores["emotional"])
587: intellectual_pct = clamp_score(category_scores["intellectual"])
588: stability_pct = clamp_score(category_scores["stability"])
589:
590: # Overall summary verdict
591: if overall_pct >= 85:
592: verdict_key = "verdict_85"
593: verdict = "Exceptional Cosmic Affinity: Rare magnetic harmony with deep mutual understanding and lasting soul connection."
594: elif overall_pct >= 70:
595: verdict_key = "verdict_70"
596: verdict = "High Astrological Resonance: Natural chemistry and supportive aspects outshine minor differences."
597: elif overall_pct >= 55:
598: verdict_key = "verdict_55"
599: verdict = "Dynamic & Complementary Bond: Meaningful passion paired with growth opportunities that require conscious empathy."
600: else:
601: verdict_key = "verdict_0"
602: verdict = "Karmic Growth Catalyst: Intense friction and distinct temperaments; great personal transformation if communication is nurtured."
603:
604: return {
605: "aspects": aspects,
606: "overall_score": overall_pct,
607: "chemistry_score": chemistry_pct,
608: "emotional_score": emotional_pct,
609: "intellectual_score": intellectual_pct,
610: "stability_score": stability_pct,
611: "verdict": verdict,
612: "verdict_key": verdict_key,
613: "raw_points": round(raw_score, 1)
614: }
615:
616: def calculate_synastry(c1, c2):
617: """Calculates all inter-chart aspects and scores for both Tropical and J2000 systems."""
618: c1_trop = c1.get("systems", {}).get("tropical", c1)
619: c2_trop = c2.get("systems", {}).get("tropical", c2)
620: c1_j2000 = c1.get("systems", {}).get("j2000", c1)
621: c2_j2000 = c2.get("systems", {}).get("j2000", c2)
622:
623: syn_tropical = _calculate_synastry_single(c1_trop, c2_trop)
624: syn_j2000 = _calculate_synastry_single(c1_j2000, c2_j2000)
625:
626: return {
627: "systems": {
628: "tropical": syn_tropical,
629: "j2000": syn_j2000
630: },
631: # Default top-level fields to tropical for backwards compatibility
632: syn_tropical
633: }

642: try:

644: 'name': request.form['p1_name'].strip(),
645: 'date_str': request.form['p1_date'],
646: 'time_str': request.form['p1_time'],

654: 'city_str': request.form['p2_city'].strip(),

656: }
657:
658: # Calculate individual charts
659: chart1 = compute_chart(p1_inputs)
660: chart2 = compute_chart(**p2_inputs)
661:
662: # Calculate Synastry
663: synastry = calculate_synastry(chart1, chart2)
664:
665: # Bundle everything for frontend visualization

667: "chart1": chart1,

670: "zodiac_data": ZODIAC_DATA
671: }
672:
673: return render_template(
674: 'result.html',
675: p1=chart1,
676: p2=chart2,
677: synastry=synastry,
678: payload_json=json.dumps(payload),
679: app_version=APP_VERSION
680: )
681:

683: import traceback
684: return render_template(
685: 'index.html',
686: error=f"Error calculating charts: {str(e)}",
687: app_version=APP_VERSION

690: # --- API ROUTES ---
691: @app.route('/api/geocode', methods=['GET'])
692: def api_geocode():
693: """
694: Verify city live across curated DB and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim).
695: Tells the client exactly where it looked, if it found it, coordinates, and timezone.
696: """
697: q = request.args.get('q', '').strip()
698: if not q or len(q) < 2:
699: return jsonify({"found": False, "message": "City query is empty or too short."})
700:
701: # 1. Curated database check (Fastest, pre-verified)
702: matched = find_city_in_db(q)
703: if matched:
704: return jsonify({
705: "found": True,
706: "source": "Curated Database",
707: "name": matched["name"],
708: "display": matched["display"],
709: "lat": matched["lat"],
710: "lon": matched["lon"],
711: "tz": matched["tz"],
712: "message": f"Verified in local database: {matched['display']}"
713: })
714:
715: # 2. OpenStreetMap / Nominatim check (Worldwide coverage: towns, suburbs, villages)
716: try:
717: loc = geolocator.geocode(q)
718: if loc:
719: addr = loc.address
720: lat = round(loc.latitude, 4)
721: lon = round(loc.longitude, 4)
722:
723: # Geographic standard GMT offset without daylight saving (15 degrees per timezone hour)
724: raw_offset = round(lon / 15.0)
725: sign = "+" if raw_offset >= 0 else "-"
726: tz_est = f"{sign}{abs(int(raw_offset)):02d}:00"
727:
728: return jsonify({
729: "found": True,
730: "source": "OpenStreetMap",
731: "name": q,
732: "display": loc.address,
733: "lat": lat,
734: "lon": lon,
735: "tz": tz_est,
736: "message": f"Found on OpenStreetMap: {loc.address}"
737: })
738: else:
739: return jsonify({
740: "found": False,
741: "source": "OpenStreetMap & Local Database",
742: "query": q,
743: "message": f"Could not find '{q}' on OpenStreetMap or local list. Please check spelling or specify country (e.g. '{q}, Israel')."
744: })
745: except Exception as e:
746: return jsonify({
747: "found": False,
748: "source": "OpenStreetMap Lookup",
749: "query": q,
750: "message": f"Geocoding service error: {str(e)}"
751: })

754: def api_cities():
755: """Return filtered cities from curated database."""
756: q = request.args.get('q', '').strip().lower()
757: if not q:
758: return jsonify(CITIES_DATA[:80])

761: if q in c['display'].lower() or q in c['name'].lower() or q in c['country'].lower()
762: ]

795: if data.get("p2") and data["p2"].get("name"):

685: <!-- Bootstrap JS for modal -->

687:
688: <script>
689: let worldCities = [];
690: let savedAnalyses = [];
691: let savedPeople = [];
692: let currentSavedTab = 'analyses';
693: let editModalInstance = null;
694: let editPersonModalInstance = null;
695:
696: // Fetch Curated Cities Database
697: async function loadCities() {
698: try {
699: const res = await fetch('/api/cities');
700: worldCities = await res.json();
701: populateCitiesDatalist(worldCities);
702: } catch (err) {
703: console.error("Could not load cities:", err);
704: }
705: }
706:
707: function populateCitiesDatalist(cities) {
708: const datalist = document.getElementById('citiesList');
709: datalist.innerHTML = '';
710: cities.forEach(c => {
711: const opt = document.createElement('option');
712: opt.value = c.display;
713: opt.label = ${c.name} (${c.country}) - TZ: ${c.tz};
714: datalist.appendChild(opt);
715: });
716: }
717:
718: function findCity(val) {
719: if (!val) return null;
720: const clean = val.trim().toLowerCase();
721: return worldCities.find(c =>
722: c.display.toLowerCase() === clean ||
723: c.name.toLowerCase() === clean
724: ) || worldCities.find(c =>
725: c.display.toLowerCase().includes(clean) ||
726: clean.includes(c.name.toLowerCase())
727: );
728: }
729:
730: const cityDebounceTimers = {};
731:
732: function onCityInput(cityInputId, tzInputId, statusId) {
733: const val = document.getElementById(cityInputId).value.trim();
734: if (!val) {
735: document.getElementById(statusId).innerHTML = '';
736: return;
737: }
738:
739: // 1. Instant check in local curated database
740: const localMatch = findCity(val);
741: if (localMatch && (localMatch.name.toLowerCase() === val.toLowerCase() || localMatch.display.toLowerCase() === val.toLowerCase())) {
742: renderCitySuccess(localMatch, statusId, tzInputId, "Curated Database");
743: return;
744: }
745:
746: // 2. Debounced live check against OpenStreetMap / Nominatim
747: if (cityDebounceTimers[cityInputId]) clearTimeout(cityDebounceTimers[cityInputId]);
748:
749: const checkingMsg = window.t ? window.t('checkingLocation') : 'Checking location on OpenStreetMap & local database...';
750: document.getElementById(statusId).innerHTML = `
751: <div class="searching-badge">
752: <span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm" role="status" style="width: 0.8rem; height: 0.8rem;"></span>
753: <span>${checkingMsg}</span>
754: </div>
755: `;
756:
757: cityDebounceTimers[cityInputId] = setTimeout(() => {
758: verifyCityLive(val, statusId, tzInputId);
759: }, 450);
760: }
761:
762: function onCitySelected(cityInputId, tzInputId, statusId) {
763: const val = document.getElementById(cityInputId).value.trim();
764: if (cityDebounceTimers[cityInputId]) clearTimeout(cityDebounceTimers[cityInputId]);
765: verifyCityLive(val, statusId, tzInputId);
766: }
767:
768: function triggerCityVerify(cityInputId, tzInputId, statusId) {
769: const val = document.getElementById(cityInputId).value.trim();
770: if (!val) {
771: alert(window.t ? window.t('enterCityAlert') : "Please enter a city name to verify.");
772: return;
773: }

236: // Detailed Aspect Interpretations
237: aspectMeanings: {
238: "Sun-Moon-Conjunction": "היבט הנישואין השמיימי. הבנה הדדית אינטואיטיבית ברמת הנשמה, הרמוניה רגשית עמוקה והתאמה טבעית.",
239: "Sun-Moon-Trine": "תהודה טבעית וזורמת בין האגו והרגשות. אתם מעניקים ביטחון, חיזוק ונחמה אינסטינקטיביים לעולמות הפנימיים זה של זו.",
240: "Sun-Moon-Sextile": "זיקה ידידותית ושיתופית. אתם מתקשרים כוונות בבהירות ותומכים הדדית בצמיחה ובהתפתחות של בן/בת הזוג.",
241: "Sun-Moon-Opposition": "קוטביות מגנטית עוצמתית. משיכה עזה המשלבת השקפות עולם שונות; יוצרת צמיחה הדדית באמצעות שונות משלימה.",
242: "Sun-Moon-Square": "מתח יצירתי בין כוח הרצון לפגיעות הרגשית. דורש אמפתיה מודעת כדי לגשר על מזגים רגשיים שונים.",
243:
244: "Venus-Mars-Conjunction": "משיכה פיזית מחשמלת ומגנטיות רומנטית ראשונית. ניצוץ מיידי עם כימיה חושנית וסוערת.",
245: "Venus-Mars-Trine": "זרימה רומנטית מוזהבת. פיתוי, תשוקה וחיבה משתלבים ללא מאמץ, ומייצרים תשוקה מתמשכת נטולת עוינות.",
246: "Venus-Mars-Sextile": "כימיה שובבה ומלאת חיים. קלילות פלרטטנית עם הערכה טבעית לסגנון הרומנטי של בן/בת הזוג.",
247: "Venus-Mars-Square": "חיכוך מיני בעוצמה גבוהה. תשוקה לוהטת וממכרת הדורשת ערוצי ביטוי בונים כדי למנוע התנגשויות קטנוניות.",
248: "Venus-Mars-Opposition": "משיכה מגנטית בלתי ניתנת לעצירה בין קטבים מנוגדים. המרדף מלהיב, אך איזון בין חיבה לאגו דורש סבלנות.",
249:
250: "Venus-Venus-Conjunction": "טעמים אסתטיים משותפים, שפות אהבה זהות ומקצבים חברתיים תואמים. אתם חווים הנאה ויופי מאותה נקודת מבט.",
251: "Venus-Venus-Trine": "רוך טבעי וחיבה הדדית זורמת. קשר מרגיע ומנחם המרכך מתחים יומיומיים.",
252: "Venus-Venus-Square": "סגנונות הבעת אהבה שונים או הרגלי בילוי והוצאות מגוונים. מהנה ומעורר עניין ברגע שמחבקים את ההבדלים.",
253:
254: "Moon-Moon-Conjunction": "קרבה רגשית טלפתית. אתם מרגישים כמו 'בית' זה עבור זו ומשקפים ברגישות את הפגיעות ההדדית.",
255: "Moon-Moon-Trine": "ביטחון רגשי עמוק, רוך ואמון אינטואיטיבי. אתם מזינים ומטפחים זה את זו באופן טבעי.",
256: "Moon-Moon-Square": "הרגלי בית שונים וקצבי עיבוד רגשי נפרדים. דורש הקשבה עדינה ומתן מרחב אישי.",
257: "Moon-Moon-Opposition": "נדנדה רגשית המפתחת מודעות עמוקה. אחד משמש כעוגן בעוד השני מבטא רגשות, בחילופים אינסטינקטיביים.",
258:
259: "Sun-Sun-Trine": "ערכי ליבה הרמוניים, הערכה הדדית עמוקה וחזון משותף לחיים של משמעות והגשמה.",
260: "Sun-Sun-Conjunction": "חיוניות עוצמתית ואור זרקורים משותף. אתם מעצימים זה את זו באנרגיה, אך מרחב לריבונות אישית חיוני.",
261: "Sun-Sun-Square": "אתגר דינמי של כוחות רצון. אישיויות חזקות הדוחפות זו את זו לשיאי שאפתנות, כל עוד התחרות נשמרת בריאה.",
262: "Sun-Sun-Opposition": "דינמיקת מראה מרתקת. כל בן זוג רואה חלקים לא מבוטאים של עצמו משתקפים בבן/בת הזוג.",
263:
264: "Mercury-Mercury-Conjunction": "סנכרון מחשבתי מהיר באותו אורך גל. שעות נעלמות בשיחות קולחות כשאתם משלימים זה את משפטי זו.",
265: "Mercury-Mercury-Trine": "קשר אינטלקטואלי מעורר השראה. שיתוף פעולה בפרויקטים יצירתיים, אנליטיים או מעשיים זורם בקלות.",
266: "Mercury-Mercury-Square": "דיונים סוערים ומקצבי תקשורת שונים. מגרה ומעורר מחשבה, אך הקשבה פעילה חיונית למניעת אי-הבנות.",
267:
268: "Jupiter-Sun-Trine": "שפע של מזל טוב, אופטימיות ועידוד הדדי נדיב. אתם מרחיבים זה לזו את האופקים ומגבירים את המזל.",
269: "Jupiter-Moon-Trine": "חום מלבב, הומור ונוחות פסיכולוגית מנחמת. מערכת יחסים המאופיינת בשמחת חיים, קלילות וסלחנות.",
270: "Saturn-Sun-Trine": "סלע איתן של מחויבות מתמשכת, נאמנות וכבוד הדדי. קשר שנבנה לעמוד במבחן הזמן ובאתגרי המציאות.",
271: "Saturn-Venus-Trine": "נאמנות בלתי מעורערת ואהבה יציבה עם שורשים עמוקים. חיבה המבשילה לאחריות הדדית ומסירות לטווח ארוך.",
272: "Saturn-Venus-Square": "שיעורים קארמתיים משמעותיים בנושאי אמון ותזמון. הבעת החיבה עשויה להרגיש זהירה, אך מבשילה עם התמדה ומסירות.",
273: "Pluto-Venus-Conjunction": "תשוקה עמוקה ומשנת חיים בעוצמה מהפנטת. אהבה בעלת עומק טרנספורמטיבי שאינה משאירה אף אחד ללא שינוי.",
274: "Pluto-Venus-Trine": "עומק רגשי ופיזי רב-עוצמה. תשוקה המרפאה כאבי עבר ומחדשת את כוחות הנפש דרך אמון מוחלט.",
275: "Neptune-Venus-Trine": "רומנטיקה פיוטית מהאגדות ומסירות רוחנית או אמנותית ללא תנאי.",
276: "Uranus-Venus-Trine": "מתח רומנטי מחשמל ובלתי שגרתי. אפס שעמום, חופש אישי גבוה וכימיה מגנטית מתפרצת."
277: },

562: /**
563: * Get current active language key ('en' or 'he')
564: */
565: export function getCurrentLang() {
566: const saved = localStorage.getItem('astromatch_lang');
567: if (saved && TRANSLATIONS[saved]) return saved;
568: return 'en';
569: }
570:
571: /**
572: * Get string translation helper
573: */
574: export function t(key, lang = null) {
575: const activeLang = lang || getCurrentLang();
576: const dict = TRANSLATIONS[activeLang] || TRANSLATIONS.en;
577: return dict[key] !== undefined ? dict[key] : (TRANSLATIONS.en[key] !== undefined ? TRANSLATIONS.en[key] : key);
578: }
579:
580: /**
581: * Get planet translated name
582: */
583: export function tPlanet(planetName, lang = null) {
584: const activeLang = lang || getCurrentLang();
585: const dict = TRANSLATIONS[activeLang] || TRANSLATIONS.en;
586: return (dict.planets && dict.planets[planetName]) || planetName;
587: }
588:
589: /**
590: * Get zodiac translated name
591: */
592: export function tZodiac(signName, lang = null) {
593: const activeLang = lang || getCurrentLang();
594: const dict = TRANSLATIONS[activeLang] || TRANSLATIONS.en;
595: return (dict.zodiac && dict.zodiac[signName]) || signName;
596: }

599: * Get element translated name
600: */
601: export function tElement(elementName, lang = null) {
602: const activeLang = lang || getCurrentLang();
603: const dict = TRANSLATIONS[activeLang] || TRANSLATIONS.en;
604: return (dict.elements && dict.elements[elementName]) || elementName;

607: /**
608: * Get aspect translated name
609: */
610: export function tAspect(aspectName, lang = null) {
611: const activeLang = lang || getCurrentLang();
612: const dict = TRANSLATIONS[activeLang] || TRANSLATIONS.en;
613: return (dict.aspectNames && dict.aspectNames[aspectName]) || aspectName;
614: }

616: /**
617: * Get aspect interpretation translated
618: */
619: export function tAspectMeaning(aspectItem, lang = null) {
620: const activeLang = lang || getCurrentLang();
621: const dict = TRANSLATIONS[activeLang] || TRANSLATIONS.en;
622:
623: if (!aspectItem) return '';
624: const key = aspectItem.aspect_key;
625: if (key && dict.aspectMeanings && dict.aspectMeanings[key]) {
626: return dict.aspectMeanings[key];
627: }
628:
629: // Check reversed pair keys
630: const p1 = aspectItem.p1_planet;
631: const p2 = aspectItem.p2_planet;
632: const asp = aspectItem.aspect;
633: const k1 = ${p1}-${p2}-${asp};
634: const k2 = ${p2}-${p1}-${asp};
635: if (dict.aspectMeanings && dict.aspectMeanings[k1]) return dict.aspectMeanings[k1];
636: if (dict.aspectMeanings && dict.aspectMeanings[k2]) return dict.aspectMeanings[k2];
637:
638: // Generic fallback translation
639: if (activeLang === 'he') {
640: const aspHe = tAspect(asp, 'he');
641: const p1He = tPlanet(p1, 'he');
642: const p2He = tPlanet(p2, 'he');
643: return חיבור פלנטרי דינמי: היבט ${aspHe} בין ${p1He} ל-${p2He} יוצר תחלופת אנרגיה פעילה והשפעה הדדית משמעותית.;
644: }
645: return aspectItem.meaning || Dynamic planetary link: ${asp} between ${p1} and ${p2} creates active energy exchange.;
646: }
647:
648: /**
649: * Get score summary verdict translated
650: */
651: export function tVerdict(verdictKey, defaultVerdict, lang = null) {
652: const activeLang = lang || getCurrentLang();
653: const dict = TRANSLATIONS[activeLang] || TRANSLATIONS.en;
654: if (verdictKey && dict.scoreVerdicts && dict.scoreVerdicts[verdictKey]) {
655: return dict.scoreVerdicts[verdictKey];
656: }
657: return defaultVerdict || '';
658: }

660: /**
661: * Apply selected language across DOM
662: */
663: export function applyLanguage(lang) {
664: if (!TRANSLATIONS[lang]) lang = 'en';
665: localStorage.setItem('astromatch_lang', lang);
666:
667: const config = TRANSLATIONS[lang];
668: document.documentElement.lang = lang;
669: document.documentElement.dir = config.dir;
670:
671: // 1. Update elements with data-i18n
672: document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
673: const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
674: let text = config[key];
675: if (text === undefined && TRANSLATIONS.en[key] !== undefined) {
676: text = TRANSLATIONS.en[key];
677: }
678: if (text !== undefined) {
679: const version = el.getAttribute('data-version') || window.APP_VERSION || '2.2.0';
680: text = text.replace('{version}', version);
681: el.innerHTML = text;
682: }
683: });
684:
685: // 2. Update input placeholders
686: document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-placeholder]').forEach(el => {
687: const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-placeholder');
688: const text = config[key] !== undefined ? config[key] : TRANSLATIONS.en[key];
689: if (text !== undefined) {
690: el.setAttribute('placeholder', text);
691: }
692: });
693:
694: // 3. Update titles
695: document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-title]').forEach(el => {
696: const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-title');
697: const text = config[key] !== undefined ? config[key] : TRANSLATIONS.en[key];
698: if (text !== undefined) {
699: el.setAttribute('title', text);
700: }
701: });
702:
703: // 4. Update Synastry Score Summary Verdict
704: const verdictEl = document.getElementById('synastryVerdictText');
705: if (verdictEl) {
706: const vKey = verdictEl.getAttribute('data-verdict-key');
707: const defV = verdictEl.getAttribute('data-default-verdict');
708: verdictEl.textContent = tVerdict(vKey, defV, lang);
709: }
710:
711: // 5. Update Planet Position strings on Partner Cards
712: document.querySelectorAll('.planet-pos').forEach(el => {
713: const rawFormatted = el.getAttribute('data-formatted') || '';
714: const sign = el.getAttribute('data-sign');
715: const symbol = el.getAttribute('data-symbol') || '';
716: const deg = el.getAttribute('data-deg');
717: const minVal = el.getAttribute('data-min');
718:
719: if ((deg === null || deg === undefined || deg === '') && rawFormatted) {
720: el.textContent = rawFormatted;
721: return;
722: }
723:
724: const min = (minVal !== null && minVal !== undefined && minVal !== '') ? String(minVal).padStart(2, '0') : '00';
725: const signTranslated = tZodiac(sign, lang);
726: if (lang === 'he') {
727: el.innerHTML = ${signTranslated} <span style="color: inherit;">${symbol}</span> <span dir="ltr" style="display:inline-block;">${deg}° ${min}'</span>;
728: } else {
729: el.innerHTML = <span dir="ltr" style="display:inline-block;">${deg}° ${min}'</span> <span style="color: inherit;">${symbol}</span> ${signTranslated};
730: }
731: });
732:
733: // 6. Update Location Source Badges
734: document.querySelectorAll('.location-source-badge').forEach(el => {
735: const src = el.getAttribute('data-source') || '';
736: if (src === 'Curated Database') {
737: el.textContent = t('curatedDatabaseBadge', lang);
738: } else if (src.includes('Nominatim') || src.includes('OpenStreetMap')) {
739: el.textContent = t('osmBadge', lang);
740: } else {
741: el.textContent = src;
742: }
743: });
744:
745: // 7. Update Natal Map Tab Buttons
746: document.querySelectorAll('.tab-natal-btn').forEach(btn => {
747: const pName = btn.getAttribute('data-name');
748: const partner = btn.getAttribute('data-partner');
749: const icon = partner === 'p1' ? '🪐' : '🌙';

751: btn.textContent = ${icon} מפת לידה: ${pName};

802: @app.route('/api/analyses/<analysis_id>', methods=['GET'])
803: def api_get_single_analysis(analysis_id):
804: """Retrieve a single saved analysis."""
805: saved = load_saved_analyses()
806: item = next((x for x in saved if x["id"] == analysis_id), None)
807: if not item:
808: return jsonify({"error": "Analysis not found"}), 404
809: return jsonify(item)

811: @app.route('/api/analyses/<analysis_id>', methods=['PUT'])
812: def api_update_analysis(analysis_id):
813: """Update an existing analysis profile."""
814: try:
815: data = request.get_json(force=True)
816: saved = load_saved_analyses()
817: idx = next((i for i, x in enumerate(saved) if x["id"] == analysis_id), None)
818: if idx is None:
819: return jsonify({"error": "Analysis not found"}), 404
820:
821: item = saved[idx]
822: if "title" in data: item["title"] = data["title"]
823: if "p1" in data: item["p1"] = data["p1"]
824: if "p2" in data: item["p2"] = data["p2"]
825: if "notes" in data: item["notes"] = data["notes"]
826: item["version"] = data.get("version") or item.get("version") or APP_VERSION
827: item["updated_at"] = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
828:
829: saved[idx] = item
830: save_analyses_to_file(saved)
831: return jsonify({"success": True, "analysis": item})
832: except Exception as err:
833: return jsonify({"error": str(err)}), 500

835: @app.route('/api/analyses/<analysis_id>', methods=['DELETE'])
836: def api_delete_analysis(analysis_id):
837: """Delete a saved analysis profile."""
838: try:
839: saved = load_saved_analyses()
840: initial_len = len(saved)
841: saved = [x for x in saved if x["id"] != analysis_id]
842: if len(saved) == initial_len:
843: return jsonify({"error": "Analysis not found"}), 404
844: save_analyses_to_file(saved)
845: return jsonify({"success": True, "deleted_id": analysis_id})
846: except Exception as err:
847: return jsonify({"error": str(err)}), 500

733:
734: <script>
735: const astroData = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('astroData').textContent);
736: const { chart1, chart2, synastry, zodiac_data } = astroData;
737:
738: let currentCoordSystem = 'tropical'; // 'tropical' | 'j2000'
739:
740: function getActiveChart(baseChart) {
741: if (!baseChart) return null;
742: if (baseChart.systems && baseChart.systems[currentCoordSystem]) {
743: return {
744: ...baseChart,
745: ...baseChart.systems[currentCoordSystem]
746: };
747: }
748: return baseChart;
749: }
750:
751: function getActiveSynastry() {
752: if (!synastry) return null;
753: if (synastry.systems && synastry.systems[currentCoordSystem]) {
754: return {
755: ...synastry,
756: ...synastry.systems[currentCoordSystem]
757: };
758: }
759: return synastry;
760: }
761:
762: let currentMode = 'synastry'; // 'synastry' | 'natal1' | 'natal2'
763: let activeAspectFilter = 'all';
764:
765: const CX = 450;
766: const CY = 450;
767: const R_OUTER = 440;
768: const R_ZODIAC_OUT = 430;
769: const R_ZODIAC_IN = 370;
770:
771: // Astrological coordinate conversion: Ascendant placed at 9 o'clock (180 deg)
772: // Standard chart math: Longitude increases counter-clockwise
773: function lonToSvgAngle(lonDeg, ascDeg) {
774: // Ascendant at 180 degrees (9 o'clock)
775: return (180 - (lonDeg - ascDeg)) % 360;
776: }
777:
778: function polarToCartesian(cx, cy, r, angleDeg) {
779: const rad = (angleDeg * Math.PI) / 180.0;
780: return {
781: x: cx + r * Math.cos(rad),
782: y: cy - r * Math.sin(rad)
783: };
784: }
785:
786: function describeArc(cx, cy, rIn, rOut, startAngle, endAngle) {
787: const p1 = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, rOut, startAngle);
788: const p2 = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, rOut, endAngle);
789: const p3 = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, rIn, endAngle);
790: const p4 = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, rIn, startAngle);
791:
792: let diff = (endAngle - startAngle);
793: while (diff < 0) diff += 360;
794: const largeArc = diff > 180 ? 1 : 0;
795:
796: return [
797: "M", p1.x, p1.y,
798: "A", rOut, rOut, 0, largeArc, 0, p2.x, p2.y,
799: "L", p3.x, p3.y,
800: "A", rIn, rIn, 0, largeArc, 1, p4.x, p4.y,
801: "Z"
802: ].join(" ");
803: }
804:
805: // Draw Zodiac Ring
806: function renderZodiacRing(ascDeg) {
807: const layer = document.getElementById('zodiacRingLayer');
808: layer.innerHTML = '';
809:
810: const elementThemes = {
811: fire: { fill: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.16)', stroke: '#ef4444', text: '#fca5a5' },
812: earth: { fill: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.16)', stroke: '#10b981', text: '#6ee7b7' },
813: air: { fill: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16)', stroke: '#38bdf8', text: '#7dd3fc' },
814: water: { fill: 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.16)', stroke: '#818cf8', text: '#c7d2fe' }
815: };
816:
817: for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
818: const z = zodiac_data[i];
819: const startLon = z.start;
820: const endLon = (z.start + 30) % 360;
821:
822: const startAngle = lonToSvgAngle(startLon, ascDeg);
823: const endAngle = lonToSvgAngle(endLon, ascDeg);
824:
825: const theme = elementThemes[z.element];
826: const d = describeArc(CX, CY, R_ZODIAC_IN, R_ZODIAC_OUT, startAngle, endAngle);
827:
828: const path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
829: path.setAttribute('d', d);
830: path.setAttribute('fill', theme.fill);
831: path.setAttribute('stroke', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)');
832: path.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1');
833: layer.appendChild(path);
834:
835: // Midpoint for glyph & label
836: const midAngle = lonToSvgAngle(startLon + 15, ascDeg);
837: const glyphPos = polarToCartesian(CX, CY, (R_ZODIAC_IN + R_ZODIAC_OUT) / 2 + 5, midAngle);
838: const textPos = polarToCartesian(CX, CY, R_ZODIAC_IN + 12, midAngle);
839:
840: // Glyph
841: const glyphText = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
842: glyphText.setAttribute('x', glyphPos.x);
843: glyphText.setAttribute('y', glyphPos.y);
844: glyphText.setAttribute('fill', theme.text);
845: glyphText.setAttribute('font-size', '17');
846: glyphText.setAttribute('font-weight', 'bold');
847: glyphText.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
848: glyphText.setAttribute('dominant-baseline', 'central');
849: glyphText.textContent = z.symbol;
850: layer.appendChild(glyphText);
851:
852: // Small name label
853: const labelText = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
854: labelText.setAttribute('x', textPos.x);
855: labelText.setAttribute('y', textPos.y);
856: labelText.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)');
857: labelText.setAttribute('font-size', '8');
858: labelText.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
859: labelText.setAttribute('dominant-baseline', 'central');
860: labelText.textContent = z.name.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase();
861: layer.appendChild(labelText);
862: }
863:
864: // 360 degree ticks
865: for (let deg = 0; deg < 360; deg += 5) {
866: const angle = lonToSvgAngle(deg, ascDeg);
867: const isTen = deg % 10 === 0;
868: const rTick = isTen ? R_ZODIAC_OUT - 6 : R_ZODIAC_OUT - 3;
869: const p1 = polarToCartesian(CX, CY, R_ZODIAC_OUT, angle);
870: const p2 = polarToCartesian(CX, CY, rTick, angle);
871:
872: const tick = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
873: tick.setAttribute('x1', p1.x);
874: tick.setAttribute('y1', p1.y);
875: tick.setAttribute('x2', p2.x);
876: tick.setAttribute('y2', p2.y);
877: tick.setAttribute('stroke', isTen ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)');
878: tick.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1');
879: layer.appendChild(tick);
880: }
881: }

883: // Draw House Cusps
884: function renderHouseCusps(activeChart) {
885: const layer = document.getElementById('houseCuspsLayer');
886: layer.innerHTML = '';
887:
888: const ascDeg = activeChart.asc;
889: const romanHouses = ['I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII', 'VIII', 'IX', 'X', 'XI', 'XII'];
890:
891: activeChart.houses.forEach((h, idx) => {
892: const cuspDeg = h.cusp;

894: const pIn = polarToCartesian(CX, CY, 180, angle);

896:
897: const isMainAxis = (idx === 0 || idx === 3 || idx === 6 || idx === 9);

899: const line = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');

904: line.setAttribute('stroke', isMainAxis ? 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.65)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)');
905: line.setAttribute('stroke-width', isMainAxis ? '1.8' : '0.8');
906: if (!isMainAxis) line.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '3,3');
907: layer.appendChild(line);

910: let nextCusp = activeChart.houses[(idx + 1) % 12].cusp;
911: let diff = nextCusp - cuspDeg;

913: const midCuspDeg = (cuspDeg + diff / 2.0) % 360;
914: const midHouseAngle = lonToSvgAngle(midCuspDeg, ascDeg);
915:
916: const labelPos = polarToCartesian(CX, CY, 200, midHouseAngle);

935: ];

939: const angle = lonToSvgAngle(h.cusp, ascDeg);
940: const pos = polarToCartesian(CX, CY, axis.rOut, angle);
941: const text = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
942: text.setAttribute('x', pos.x);
943: text.setAttribute('y', pos.y);
944: text.setAttribute('fill', axis.color);
945: text.setAttribute('font-size', '11');
946: text.setAttribute('font-weight', 'bold');
947: text.setAttribute('text-anchor', axis.align);
948: text.setAttribute('dominant-baseline', 'central');
949:
950: if (axis.align === 'end') text.textContent = ${axis.prefix} ${h.zodiac.deg}° ${axis.suffix};
951: else if (axis.align === 'start') text.textContent = ${axis.prefix} ${h.zodiac.deg}° ${axis.suffix};
952: else text.textContent = ${axis.prefix} ${h.zodiac.deg}° ${axis.suffix};

991: // Anti-collision radial staggering algorithm
992: function drawPlanetTrack(planets, ascDeg, baseRadius, groupTag, personName, ringColor, container) {
993: // Sort by longitude to detect clusters
994: const sorted = [...planets].sort((a, b) => a.lon - b.lon);
995:
996: // Stagger radius if within 8 degrees
997: const placed = [];
998: sorted.forEach((p, i) => {
999: let r = baseRadius;
1000: if (i > 0) {
1001: const prev = placed[i - 1];
1002: let diff = Math.abs(p.lon - prev.lon);
1003: diff = Math.min(diff, 360 - diff);
1004: if (diff < 9.0) {
1005: r = prev.r === baseRadius ? baseRadius + 15 : baseRadius;
1006: }
1007: }
1008: placed.push({ ...p, r });
1009: });
1010:
1011: placed.forEach(p => {
1012: const angle = lonToSvgAngle(p.lon, ascDeg);
1013: const pos = polarToCartesian(CX, CY, p.r, angle);
1014:
1015: const g = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
1016: g.setAttribute('class', planet-badge planet-${groupTag}-${p.name.toLowerCase()});
1017: g.setAttribute('data-name', p.name);
1018: g.setAttribute('data-group', groupTag);
1019:
1020: // Glow ring
1021: const circle = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
1022: circle.setAttribute('cx', pos.x);
1023: circle.setAttribute('cy', pos.y);
1024: circle.setAttribute('r', '13.5');
1025: circle.setAttribute('fill', '#0f172a');
1026: circle.setAttribute('stroke', ringColor);
1027: circle.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.8');
1028: g.appendChild(circle);
1029:
1030: // Glyph text
1031: const glyph = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
1032: glyph.setAttribute('x', pos.x);
1033: glyph.setAttribute('y', pos.y + 0.5);
1034: glyph.setAttribute('fill', p.color || '#fff');
1035: glyph.setAttribute('font-size', '14');
1036: glyph.setAttribute('font-weight', 'bold');
1037: glyph.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
1038: glyph.setAttribute('dominant-baseline', 'central');
1039: glyph.textContent = p.symbol;
1040: g.appendChild(glyph);
1041:
1042: // Small degree badge
1043: const degP = polarToCartesian(CX, CY, p.r > baseRadius ? p.r + 17 : p.r - 17, angle);
1044: const degText = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
1045: degText.setAttribute('x', degP.x);
1046: degText.setAttribute('y', degP.y);
1047: degText.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)');
1048: degText.setAttribute('font-size', '10');
1049: degText.setAttribute('font-weight', '500');
1050: degText.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
1051: degText.setAttribute('dominant-baseline', 'central');
1052: degText.textContent = ${p.sign_deg}°;
1053: g.appendChild(degText);
1054:
1055: // Hover events
1056: g.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
1057: const isHe = (window.getCurrentLang && window.getCurrentLang() === 'he');
1058: const pNameTranslated = window.tPlanet ? window.tPlanet(p.name) : p.name;
1059: const signTranslated = window.tZodiac ? window.tZodiac(p.sign) : p.sign;
1060: const elemTranslated = window.tElement ? window.tElement(p.sign_element) : p.sign_element;
1061: const headerHtml = isHe
1062: ? ${p.symbol} ${pNameTranslated} של ${personName}
1063: : ${personName}: ${p.symbol} ${pNameTranslated};
1064: const houseText = isHe
1065: ? בית: <strong>${p.house}</strong> | יסוד: <strong style="color:${p.sign_color}">${elemTranslated}</strong>
1066: : House: <strong>${p.house}</strong> | Element: <strong style="color:${p.sign_color}">${p.sign_element}</strong>;
1067: showTooltip(e, `
1068: <div class="fw-bold" style="color: ${ringColor}">
1069: ${headerHtml}
1070: </div>
1071: <div class="text-warning small mb-1">${p.sign_deg}° ${signTranslated}</div>
1072: <div class="text-secondary small">${houseText}</div>
1073: `);
1074: highlightPlanetAspects(p.name, groupTag);
1075: });
1076:
1077: g.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
1078: hideTooltip();
1079: resetAspectHighlights();
1080: });
1081:
1082: container.appendChild(g);
1083: });
1084: }

1103:

1129: const pairLabel = isHe
1130: ? <strong style="color: var(--p1-color)">${p1Name} של ${c1.name}</strong> ↔ <strong style="color: var(--p2-color)">${p2Name} של ${c2.name}</strong>

1133:
1134: showTooltip(e, `
1135: <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-1">
1136: <span class="fw-bold" style="color: ${asp.color}">${aspName} (${asp.angle}°)</span>
1137: <span class="badge bg-dark">${orbBadge}</span>
1138: </div>
1139: <div class="small mb-1 text-light">
1140: ${pairLabel}
1141: </div>
1142: <div class="small text-secondary" style="font-size:0.78rem;">${meaningText}</div>
1143: `);
1144: });
1145:
1146: line.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTooltip);
1147:
1148: layer.appendChild(line);
1149: });
1150: } else {
1151: const chart = mode === 'natal1' ? c1 : c2;
1152: chart.natal_aspects.forEach((asp) => {
1153: if (activeAspectFilter !== 'all' && asp.aspect !== activeAspectFilter) {
1154: return;
1155: }
1156:
1157: const angle1 = lonToSvgAngle(asp.p1_lon, chart.asc);
1158: const angle2 = lonToSvgAngle(asp.p2_lon, chart.asc);
1159:
1160: const p1 = polarToCartesian(CX, CY, 250, angle1);
1161: const p2 = polarToCartesian(CX, CY, 250, angle2);
1162:
1163: const line = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
1164: line.setAttribute('x1', p1.x);
1165: line.setAttribute('y1', p1.y);
1166: line.setAttribute('x2', p2.x);
1167: line.setAttribute('y2', p2.y);
1168: line.setAttribute('stroke', asp.color);
1169: line.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.6');
1170: line.setAttribute('stroke-opacity', '0.65');
1171: line.setAttribute('class', aspect-chord aspect-${asp.aspect.toLowerCase()});
1172:
1173: line.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
1174: const isHe = (window.getCurrentLang && window.getCurrentLang() === 'he');

1177: const p2Name = window.tPlanet ? window.tPlanet(asp.p2) : asp.p2;
1178: const titleText = isHe ? היבט מולדת: ${aspName} (${asp.angle}°) : Natal ${asp.aspect} (${asp.angle}°);

1258: // Render Data Tables
1259: function renderDataTables(mode) {
1260: const gridContainer = document.getElementById('aspectGridContainer');
1261: const tableContainer = document.getElementById('planetTableContainer');
1262: const c1 = getActiveChart(chart1);
1263: const c2 = getActiveChart(chart2);
1264: const syn = getActiveSynastry();
1265:
1266: const formatPos = (p) => {
1267: if (!p || !p.formatted) return '-';
1268: const parts = p.formatted.split(' ');
1269: if (parts.length < 4) return <span dir="ltr">${p.formatted}</span>; // Fallback
1270: const deg = parts[0];
1271: const min = parts[1];
1272: const sym = parts[2];
1273: const signName = parts[3];
1274:
1275: const isHe = (window.getCurrentLang && window.getCurrentLang() === 'he');
1276: const translatedSign = window.tZodiac ? window.tZodiac(p.sign || signName) : signName;
1277:
1278: if (isHe) {
1279: return ${translatedSign} <span style="color: ${p.sign_color || '#fff'}">${sym}</span> <span dir="ltr" style="display:inline-block;">${deg} ${min}</span>;
1280: }
1281: return <span dir="ltr" style="display:inline-block;">${deg} ${min}</span> <span style="color: ${p.sign_color || '#fff'}">${sym}</span> ${translatedSign};
1282: };
1283:
1284: // 1. Planetary Data Table
1285: const chart = mode === 'synastry' ? null : (mode === 'natal1' ? c1 : c2);
1286: let htmlTable = '';
1287:
1288: if (chart) {
1289: // Natal Data Table
1290: htmlTable = `<table class="data-table">
1291: <thead>
1292: <tr>
1293: <th>Body</th>
1294: <th>Longitude</th>
1295: <th>House</th>
1296: </tr>
1297: </thead>
1298: <tbody>`;
1299: const allPoints = [...chart.planets, chart.asc_point, chart.mc_point];
1300: allPoints.forEach(p => {
1301: const isHe = (window.getCurrentLang && window.getCurrentLang() === 'he');
1302: const pName = window.tPlanet ? window.tPlanet(p.name) : p.name;
1303: htmlTable += `<tr>
1304: <td><strong style="color: ${p.color || '#fff'}">${p.symbol}</strong> ${pName}</td>
1305: <td>${formatPos(p)}</td>
1306: <td>${p.house || '-'}</td>
1307: </tr>`;
1308: });
1309: htmlTable += </tbody></table>;
1310: } else {
1311: // Synastry Data Table
1312: htmlTable = `<table class="data-table" style="font-size: 0.8rem;">
1313: <thead>
1314: <tr>
1315: <th>Body</th>
1316: <th style="color: var(--p1-color)">${c1.name}</th>
1317: <th style="color: var(--p2-color)">${c2.name}</th>
1318: </tr>
1319: </thead>
1320: <tbody>`;
1321: const names = ['Sun', 'Moon', 'Mercury', 'Venus', 'Mars', 'Jupiter', 'Saturn', 'Uranus', 'Neptune', 'Pluto', 'Ascendant', 'Midheaven'];
1322: const p1Dict = {...c1.planets_dict, 'Ascendant': c1.asc_point, 'Midheaven': c1.mc_point};
1323: const p2Dict = {...c2.planets_dict, 'Ascendant': c2.asc_point, 'Midheaven': c2.mc_point};
1324:
1325: names.forEach(n => {
1326: const p1 = p1Dict[n];
1327: const p2 = p2Dict[n];
1328: if(p1 && p2) {
1329: const pName = window.tPlanet ? window.tPlanet(n) : n;
1330: htmlTable += `<tr>
1331: <td><strong style="color: ${p1.color}">${p1.symbol}</strong> ${pName}</td>
1332: <td>${formatPos(p1)}</td>
1333: <td>${formatPos(p2)}</td>
1334: </tr>`;
1335: }
1336: });
1337: htmlTable += </tbody></table>;
1338: }
1339: tableContainer.innerHTML = htmlTable;
1340:
1341: // 2. Aspect Grid
1342: let htmlGrid = '<table class="astro-grid-table">';
1343:
1344: const getSym = (chartObj, name) => {
1345: if(name === 'Ascendant') return chartObj.asc_point.symbol;
1346: if(name === 'Midheaven') return chartObj.mc_point.symbol;
1347: return chartObj.planets_dict[name] ? chartObj.planets_dict[name].symbol : name;
1348: };
1349: const aspectLookup = {};
1350: const getAspectChar = (aspName) => {
1351: const map = {
1352: 'Conjunction': '☌', 'Opposition': '☍', 'Trine': '△', 'Square': '□', 'Sextile': '⚹'
1353: };
1354: return map[aspName] || aspName;
1355: };
1356:
1357: if (mode === 'synastry') {
1358: // Synastry Grid: P1 on Y-axis, P2 on X-axis
1359: const pts1 = [...c1.planets, c1.asc_point].map(p => p.name);
1360: const pts2 = [...c2.planets, c2.asc_point].map(p => p.name);
1361:
1362: syn.aspects.forEach(asp => {
1363: aspectLookup[${asp.p1_planet}-${asp.p2_planet}] = asp;
1364: });
1365:
1366: htmlGrid += '<thead><tr><th></th>';
1367: pts2.forEach(p2 => {
1368: htmlGrid += <th style="color: var(--p2-color)">${getSym(c2, p2)}</th>;
1369: });
1370: htmlGrid += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
1371:
1372: pts1.forEach(p1 => {
1373: htmlGrid += <tr><th style="color: var(--p1-color)">${getSym(c1, p1)}</th>;
1374: pts2.forEach(p2 => {
1375: const key = ${p1}-${p2};
1376: const asp = aspectLookup[key];
1377: if (asp) {
1378: htmlGrid += `<td class="aspect-cell" style="color: ${asp.color}">
1379: ${getAspectChar(asp.aspect)}<br/><small>${asp.orb}°</small>
1380: </td>`;
1381: } else {
1382: htmlGrid += <td></td>;
1383: }
1384: });
1385: htmlGrid += </tr>;
1386: });
1387: htmlGrid += '</tbody></table>';
1388:
1389: } else {
1390: // Natal Grid (Triangular)
1391: const c = mode === 'natal1' ? c1 : c2;
1392: const pts = [...c.planets, c.asc_point].map(p => p.name);
1393:
1394: c.natal_aspects.forEach(asp => {
1395: aspectLookup[${asp.p1}-${asp.p2}] = asp;
1396: aspectLookup[${asp.p2}-${asp.p1}] = asp;
1397: });
1398:
1399: htmlGrid += '<tbody>';
1400: for(let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
1401: const pY = pts[i];
1402: htmlGrid += <tr><th style="color: ${c.planets_dict[pY] ? c.planets_dict[pY].color : '#ec4899'}">${getSym(c, pY)}</th>;
1403: for(let j = 0; j < i; j++) {
1404: const pX = pts[j];
1405: const key = ${pY}-${pX};
1406: const asp = aspectLookup[key];
1407: if (asp) {
1408: htmlGrid += `<td class="aspect-cell" style="color: ${asp.color}">
1409: ${getAspectChar(asp.aspect)}<br/><small>${asp.orb}°</small>
1410: </td>`;
1411: } else {
1412: htmlGrid += <td></td>;
1413: }
1414: }
1415: htmlGrid += </tr>;
1416: }
1417:
1418: htmlGrid += '<tr><th></th>';
1419: for(let j = 0; j < pts.length - 1; j++) {
1420: const pX = pts[j];
1421: htmlGrid += <th style="color: ${c.planets_dict[pX] ? c.planets_dict[pX].color : '#ec4899'}">${getSym(c, pX)}</th>;
1422: }
1423: htmlGrid += '</tr></tbody></table>';
1424: }
1425:
1426: gridContainer.innerHTML = htmlGrid;
1427: }

1429: // Coordinate Switcher Handler
1430: function setCoordinateSystem(sys) {
1431: if (sys !== 'tropical' && sys !== 'j2000') return;
1432: currentCoordSystem = sys;
1433:
1434: // 1. Update toggle buttons UI
1435: const btnTrop = document.getElementById('btn-coord-tropical');
1436: const btnJ2000 = document.getElementById('btn-coord-j2000');
1437: if (btnTrop && btnJ2000) {
1438: if (sys === 'tropical') {
1439: btnTrop.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-warning fw-semibold px-2 py-1';
1440: btnJ2000.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-outline-warning px-2 py-1';
1441: } else {
1442: btnTrop.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-outline-warning px-2 py-1';
1443: btnJ2000.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-warning fw-semibold px-2 py-1';
1444: }
1445: }
1446:
1447: // 2. Update badge on Planetary Data table
1448: const badge = document.getElementById('activeCoordBadge');
1449: if (badge) {
1450: const isHe = (window.getCurrentLang && window.getCurrentLang() === 'he');
1451: if (sys === 'tropical') {
1452: badge.textContent = isHe ? 'טרופי (Astro.com)' : 'Tropical (Astro.com)';
1453: badge.title = isHe ? 'אסטרולוגיה מערבית סטנדרטית (נקודת שוויון לתאריך)' : 'Standard Western Astrology (Apparent Ecliptic of Date)';
1454: } else {
1455: badge.textContent = isHe ? 'J2000 (אסטרומטרי)' : 'J2000 (Astrometric)';
1456: badge.title = isHe ? 'נקודת ייחוס אסטרונומית קבועה J2000.0' : 'IAU Standard Epoch J2000.0';
1457: }
1458: }
1459:
1460: // 3. Update Partner Big Three Cards at the top
1461: updatePartnerCards(sys);
1462:
1463: // 4. Update Synastry Score Circle, Rating, and Bars
1464: updateScores(sys);
1465:
1466: // 5. Re-render the Aspect Cards list
1467: renderAspectCardsList(getActiveSynastry().aspects);
1468:
1469: // 6. Redraw Wheel, Data Table, and Aspect Grid
1470: redrawWheel();
1471: }
1472: window.setCoordinateSystem = setCoordinateSystem;
1473:
1474: function updatePartnerCards(sys) {
1475: const c1 = getActiveChart(chart1);

1968: <script>

1983: function populateModalPeopleDropdowns() {

1988: let opts = <option value="">${chooseText}</option>;

1991: });
1992: select.innerHTML = opts;
1993: });
1994: }

1996: function onModalSelectPerson(partner, personId) {
1997: if (!personId) return;

1999: if (!person) return;
2000:
2001: document.getElementById(modal_${partner}_name).value = person.name || '';
2002: document.getElementById(modal_${partner}_date).value = person.date || '';
2003: document.getElementById(modal_${partner}_time).value = person.time || '12:00';
2004: document.getElementById(modal_${partner}_city).value = person.city || '';
2005: document.getElementById(modal_${partner}_tz).value = person.tz || '+03:00';
2006: }

2012: const v2 = document.getElementById(modal_p2_${f}).value;
2013: document.getElementById(modal_p1_${f}).value = v2;
2014: document.getElementById(modal_p2_${f}).value = v1;
2015: });
2016: }

2018: function updateReportSavedBadges() {
2019: const p1Badge = document.getElementById('p1_result_saved_badge');
2020: const p2Badge = document.getElementById('p2_result_saved_badge');
2021:
2022: const p1Name = "{{ p1.name }}".trim().toLowerCase();
2023: const p2Name = "{{ p2.name }}".trim().toLowerCase();
2024:
2025: const p1Match = resultSavedPeople.find(p => p.name.trim().toLowerCase() === p1Name);
2026: const p2Match = resultSavedPeople.find(p => p.name.trim().toLowerCase() === p2Name);
2027:
2028: if (p1Badge) {
2029: if (p1Match) {
2030: p1Badge.innerHTML = <span class="badge bg-success bg-opacity-20 text-success border border-success border-opacity-40 px-2 py-0" style="font-size: 0.72rem;">✓ Saved</span>;
2031: } else {

2033: }

2039: } else {
2040: p2Badge.innerHTML = <button type="button" class="btn btn-xs btn-outline-info py-0 px-2 rounded-pill" style="font-size: 0.7rem;" onclick="savePersonFromReport('p2')">💾 Save</button>;
2041: }
2042: }

2045: async function savePersonFromReport(partner) {
2046: const isP1 = partner === 'p1';
2047: const payload = {
2048: name: isP1 ? "{{ p1.name }}" : "{{ p2.name }}",
2049: date: isP1 ? "{{ p1.date }}" : "{{ p2.date }}",
2050: time: isP1 ? "{{ p1.time }}" : "{{ p2.time }}",
2051: city: isP1 ? "{{ p1.city }}" : "{{ p2.city }}",
2052: tz: isP1 ? "{{ p1.tz }}" : "{{ p2.tz }}",
2053: version: window.APP_VERSION || "{{ app_version }}"
2054: };
2055:
2056: try {
2057: const res = await fetch('/api/people', {
2058: method: 'POST',
2059: headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
2060: body: JSON.stringify(payload)
2061: });
2062: if (res.ok) {
2063: await fetchSavedPeopleForResult();
2064: } else {
2065: alert("Failed to save person.");
2066: }
2067: } catch (err) {
2068: alert("Error saving person: " + err);
2069: }
2070: }

2079: const sel = document.getElementById('modal_p2_person_select');
2080: if (sel) sel.focus();
2081: }, 350);
2082: }
2083: }

2085: function escapeHtml(text) {
2086: if (!text) return '';
2087: return text
2088: .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
2089: .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
2090: .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
2091: .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
2092: .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
2093: }

439: def compute_chart(name, date_str, time_str, tz_str, city_str):
440: """Calculates all planetary coordinates, angles, houses, and natal aspects."""
441: # Resolve City Coordinates (Curated DB first, then live OpenStreetMap/Nominatim fallback)
442: matched_city = find_city_in_db(city_str)
443: if matched_city:
444: lat, lon = matched_city['lat'], matched_city['lon']
445: address = matched_city['display']

448: location = geolocator.geocode(city_str)

450: raise ValueError(f"Could not locate '{city_str}' on OpenStreetMap or local database. Please check spelling or specify country (e.g., 'Kiryat Gat, Israel').")
451: lat, lon = location.latitude, location.longitude
452: address = location.address
453: source = "OpenStreetMap"

455: # Parse date and time
456: dt = datetime.strptime(f"{date_str} {time_str}", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

458: # Parse timezone offset e.g. +02:00, -05:00, +2, -5
459: try:

462: core = tz_clean.lstrip('+-')

465: h = int(parts[0])
466: m = int(parts[1])
467: else:
